manufacturer.name: Genie
manufacturer.note: US garage door opener manufacturer. Owner's manuals are served from its own support portal. Genie publishes per-model product-support pages rather than linking PDFs that search can reach; several searches have surfaced those pages and retailer-hosted copies, but no geniecompany.com PDF. Its support site tells owners to phone or visit the site to download, which is why the records here point at support pages and retailer copies.

documents.evidence: Third-party copy. One manual covers four series, so the record names all four rather than implying it is specific to one. No manufacturer-hosted PDF URL was surfaced; the Genie support portal is recorded at manufacturer level instead. Not fetched - egress blocked.

documents.title: Genie Model 3055 SilentMax 750 Product Support
documents.evidence: On geniecompany.com, the manufacturer's own domain. This is the model's support page, not a PDF - no geniecompany.com document URL surfaced. Recorded because the page is the manufacturer's own entry point for this model and a technician can get to the manual from it; typed USER_MANUAL as the closest honest fit, with this note saying plainly it is a page. ChainMax 750 is an alias because the search conflated the two names; whether they are the same opener was not established. Not fetched - egress blocked.
